tool.name: OGS: GocadSGridReader
tool.description: Reads a Gocad stratigraphic grid file (file ending sg) and writes the data in the vtk unstructured grid file format.
tool.command: #for $item in $sg_members ln -sf '$item' '$item.element_identifier'; #end for ln -sf '$sg' 'sg.sg'; GocadSGridReader $generate_face_sets --sg 'sg.sg' --output-mesh output_1.vtu

param.name: sg_members
param.label: sg referenced files
param.help: Data files referenced by the .sg header (points, flags and properties). Their names must match the entries in the .sg file.

tool.help: Reads a Gocad stratigraphic grid file (file ending sg) and writes the data in the vtk unstructured grid file format. The documentation is available at https://www.opengeosys.org/docs/tools/meshing/gocadsgridreader/.
